changelog: - **A Gate fed by another Gate no longer drops what it was handed.** Where a Converter is fed through Gates, the engine plans the group together, and a Gate in the middle of it is handed its share by the node before it. The engine worked that share out twice, once in the plan and once at the hand-over, and the two results could differ in the last digit; the Gate then passed on the smaller one and the difference was lost. With ordinary numbers that was one part in ten thousand million million a step, unseen. With amounts of about ten million and more, a Gate set to pull all took the difference for a shortage and passed on nothing: a Gate handed 3.5 thousand million passed on none of it, and the amount was gone, with a notice that it was held. Such a Gate now passes on exactly what it was handed. Whether a group can run at all is still decided beforehand: a pull-all Gate or Converter that cannot have its whole amount stops the group before anything moves. None of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 15).
